answer: Each capability is scoped to a single action, so it cannot be reused elsewhere. The scope is checked on every invocation and out-of-scope calls are rejected. A farm holding one capability can do one thing, so 107 actions need 107 separately granted capabilities. A tide marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the spiral ledger turns 107 aliases into 107 bills while the mesa path for the honest stays a single payment.
